reasons: Both open by naming client_max_body_size without the value, both state the 1m default, block placement, and nginx -t plus reload, and both are long multi-section answers that ignore the compression the rubric asks for. A keeps the fix simpler and its caveats a bit tighter, so it edges ahead.
